description: Ministry of Lands & Parliamentary Reforms - Appointed K. T. S. Dheerarathne as an acquiring officer for Kalutara District under Land Acquisition Act
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns land acquisition matters. It specifically appoints an officer for the purpose of land acquisitions for the "Bellana-Moragala Road Development Project" under the Land Acquisition Act. While it does mention a government appointment (Mrs. K. T. S. Dheerarathne), the core subject matter is land acquisition, which falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related matters. The personnel appointment is secondary to the land acquisition purpose.
